title: Credit exhausted; only the failed-call log shows it
question: Verification codes are not coming at all since early morning. Is something broken?

expected.notes: Delivery reports stop after 03:00 with no failures. The failed-call log holds code E101 records from 03:00. The report quotes the code and count, and notes paused requests can be replayed for a limited time after a top-up and that replayed verification codes may already have expired. The code E101 is invented.
